title: Daily API Digest to Slack
summary: Pull records from any JSON API, summarise them, and post a digest to Slack on a schedule.
trigger: Manual run, or attach a daily schedule in Studio

secrets.name: DIGEST_API_URL
secrets.description: Full URL of the JSON endpoint to read, without the query string.

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Slack bot token with the `chat:write` scope.

secrets.name: SLACK_DIGEST_CHANNEL
secrets.description: Channel id or name to post to, for example `#ops`.

setup: Run the playbook once manually to check the digest.
In Studio, add a schedule (for example `0 9 * * *`) to run it every morning.
